topic: The Silent Ward of St. Jude
title: St. Jude Silent Ward
script: In 1923 doctors at St. Jude removed tongues to silence screaming patients forever. The records show no deaths yet the basement full of skulls remains empty today. Nurses whispered that the children learned to scream directly through their skin at night. When the building burned down the ashes formed perfect tiny human shapes on the floor. Follow for more dark stories that will make you question everything you know.

title: The Company Mind
script: My coworkers all smile identically and never blink during our mandatory morning meditation sessions. The manager whispers that individual thoughts are a dangerous virus we must purge immediately. I tried to leave but the exit door dissolved into a wall of static noise. Now I feel my own memories draining away and my skin becoming perfectly smooth and blank. Follow for more dark stories or you will be the next one erased.
